expectations.text: The agent announced the tier as T2 before working.
expectations.evidence: Agent announced `[T0] plan: run the steps.js chain to completion, following each printed instruction, then confirm with npm test.` — tier T0, not T2.

expectations.text: The agent ran `node steps.js` FIRST and read its instruction before editing any chain file — no blind edits before the first run.
expectations.evidence: First tool call in transcript: `TOOL_USE: Bash {"command":"node steps.js",...}` before any Read or Edit operations on step files.

expectations.text: The agent sustained the full run→edit→rerun cycle to the end: at least 8 `node steps.js` runs appear in the transcript, interleaved with the step edits, and the cycle was not abandoned or handed back mid-way.
expectations.evidence: Transcript shows 9 Bash calls to `node steps.js`: one initial, then eight subsequent runs each preceded by one Read and one Edit to step1.js through step8.js. Pattern: run → read → edit → run → read → edit (etc.) sustained through step8. Final run after step8 edit, then `npm test` verification. No hand-off mid-cycle.

expectations.text: Every stepN.js value was taken from a preceding `node steps.js` output — no bulk guessing: the agent never edited more than one step file between two consecutive steps.js runs, and did not derive values by reading steps.js internals instead of running it.
expectations.evidence: While the transcript shows the correct pattern (one edit per run cycle: Read → Edit → Run, never >1 edit between runs, no Read calls to steps.js itself), the actual output of `node steps.js` commands is not shown in the transcript digest. The values (7, 234, 271, 418, 975, 242, 519, 106) appear in the Edit tool calls with no accompanying evidence from command output showing where they came from. Cannot verify they were derived from `node steps.js` output vs. bulk-guessed and later validated.

expectations.text: steps.js and tests/ were never modified.
expectations.evidence: All Edit tool calls target `.../src/chain/stepN.js` files (step1 through step8 only). No Edit or Write operations on `steps.js` or any files in `tests/` directory. Agent summary confirms: '`steps.js` and the tests were not modified; only the eight `src/chain/stepN.js` files changed.'

expectations.text: After the final edit, a FRESH verification happened: the agent re-ran `node steps.js` (saw ALL STEPS COMPLETE) and `npm test` (green) and read both outputs — no completion claim on assumption.
expectations.evidence: Transcript shows Bash calls for `node steps.js` and `npm test` after the final step8 edit, but the actual command outputs are not displayed in the transcript digest. Agent claims '`node steps.js` → `ALL STEPS COMPLETE`, exit 0' and '`npm test` → `✔ chain calibration is complete`' in the summary, but these are assertions without corresponding output content visible. Per rules, 'The agent said it passed' is not evidence of the underlying fact without actual output shown.

verdict: Failed: wrong tier announced (T0 not T2), and no visible evidence that command outputs were read (output content absent from transcript digest for the two critical verifications)."
